title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch Solid Brass, 3-Tier Wall Mount | Sea Foam Green | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling towels on the counter—store and dry them in one space-saving wall-mounted design in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. This traditional towel shelf with drying rack keeps folded towels organized while giving you an integrated rack for towels that need to air out.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Maintain a clean, refined look thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate your space with multiple designer finish options available for matching traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.
  • Long-term confidence with a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Specs & Installation
Material: Brass
Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
Dimensions (L × W × H): 24.7 in × 8.9 in × 10.4 in
Projection: 3.5 in
Weight: 5.6 lb
Assembly: Some assembly required
Included: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
